description: First-party f-block atomic seed and reference data for GRASP2018, ATSP2K, and selected DIRAC cases.

programs.name: GRASP2018
programs.role: Relativistic orbital optimization and DC+Breit reference energies

programs.name: ATSP2K
programs.role: Nonrelativistic Hartree-Fock references and converted seed orbitals

programs.name: DIRAC
programs.role: Selected actinide ECP, all-electron, and frozen-orbital CI cases

method_scope.grasp_hamiltonian: Dirac-Coulomb plus low-frequency Breit; no QED or mass shifts
method_scope.grasp_optimization: RMCDHF EAL with (2J+1) weights over all generated levels
method_scope.reference_quantity: Configuration-average energies matched to ATSP2K hf TERM=AV
method_scope.nucleus: Static Fermi nucleus with the isotope mass number recorded per element

review.scope: GRASP v2 rebuild, J-manifold coverage, configuration averages, and seed lineage
Representative answer sequences for each recorded seeding class
ATSP2K configuration-average inputs used by the GRASP v2 campaign
Converged ECP contrast case and its coupling limitation
Frozen-orbital CI route retained for further development

redistribution.source: First-party production campaign maintained in this repository
redistribution.permission_evidence: Repository-owner-authored inputs, derived scientific values, and workflow notes

known_limitations: The GRASP values are method-scoped configuration averages, not experimental truth.
The GRASP v2 rebuild fixed an earlier per-configuration J-ceiling truncation; older values must not be mixed with this catalog.
QED and mass-shift terms are absent, which matters increasingly for the heaviest elements and s-like states.
A converged SCF state may still occupy a false basin; the recorded seed and donor lineage is part of the reference.
The catalog contains 132 consumer-scoped external donor alias occurrences whose exact state or radial-wavefunction artifact is not bundled; all remain pending scientific review.
Seventeen Y extension states retain energies and J/CSF expectations but lack complete GRASP interactive-input fields; lookup remains available but input planning must report the missing fields.
DIRAC regression-failure and exploratory components are not positive workflow recommendations.
